cd /app/tmp/work && cat > zerod.py <<'PY'
import json,subprocess,sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/app/tmp/work')
import checker
cases=[
 {"epoch":1,"node_count":3,"edges":[{"tail":0,"head":1,"capacity":5},{"tail":1,"head":2,"capacity":5}],"commodities":[{"source":0,"target":2,"demand":0,"paths":[[0,1]],"previous":[16]},{"source":0,"target":1,"demand":0,"paths":[[0]],"previous":[16]}],"failed_edges":[],"budget":0},
 {"epoch":2,"node_count":4,"edges":[{"tail":0,"head":1,"capacity":3},{"tail":0,"head":1,"capacity":3},{"tail":2,"head":3,"capacity":3}],"commodities":[{"source":0,"target":1,"demand":0,"paths":[[0],[1]],"previous":[8,8]}],"failed_edges":[],"budget":0},
]
data=b"".join((json.dumps(c)+"\n").encode() for c in cases)
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"/app/submission/planner.py"],input=data,capture_output=True)
for c,l in zip(cases,p.stdout.splitlines()):
    r=json.loads(l);e,_=checker.check(c,r);print(r.get("status"),json.dumps(r)[:200],"ERRS",e)
PY
python zerod.py
echo "=== submission tree ==="
ls -la /app/submission
echo "=== stat links ==="
stat -c '%n nlink=%h type=%F' /app/submission/* 2>/dev/null
find /app/submission -type l -o -type f -links +1 2>/dev/null | sed 's/^/BAD: /'
